mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, it predicts a near-term decline in real interest rates, which boosts equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (monthly employment) above the prior quarter's average is associated with stronger consumer demand, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with PAYEMS above threshold (Pearson < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (monthly industrial production) exceeds its 12-month moving average by at least 1%, it indicates accelerating output growth, which tends to precede positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the production signal (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO (monthly index, 2017=100) below 92 for two consecutive months signals tight supply conditions, which can drive S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the contraction period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE (monthly unemployment rate) below 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS increases by more than 10% month-over-month, it reflects strong hiring momentum that supports optimism about corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no correlation with the hiring spike (Spearman < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE over the prior 3 months jointly predict a stronger negative risk premium and S&P 500 negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite both triggers (multivariate regression p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in CPIAUCSL (CPI) above 237 for 4 consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which tends to produce negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the inflation spike.
